member.name: T:NotificationDispatcher.NotificationDispatcher
member.summary: The umbrella notification sender. It holds an optional and and routes each to the right one based on its , translating to and from the provider models.

remarks.para: Either provider may be absent. A notification whose platform has no configured provider resolves to rather than throwing, so an app that only ships on one platform can register just that provider and still call this one sender.
The instance is thread-safe and designed to be long-lived, like the underlying clients; register it as a singleton.
